product_metadata.title: LEVOIT OasisMist Smart Cool and Warm Mist Humidifiers for Bedroom Large Room Home, Auto Customized Humidity, Ultrasonic Top Fill Oil Diffuser for Baby and Plants, Quiet, 4.5L, White
features: Create Your Own Oasis: After years of innovation, we’re introducing the OasisMist: a faster, healthier, smarter, and easier Warm and Cool mist humidifier. Greater than ever

Fast Relief: Using VortexMist Technology, the OasisMist can increase room humidity by 10% within 15 minutes with up to 430 ft² room coverage. Perfect for bedrooms and large rooms, Max Runtime: Up to 45 hours on low mist setting

Healthier & Reliable Mist: Run your warm and cool humidifier for up to 45 hours with low cool mist. The mist output can be up to 550mL/hr and the 4.5-L tank capacity also makes it perfect for bedrooms and large rooms.
Smarter Auto Mode: Set your ideal humidity with Auto Mode and maintain it with the built-in humidistat. No matter what moisture level you prefer, you could just set it, leave it, and enjoy it
Smarter “Oasis”: Use the free VeSync app to remotely turn on/off, schedule timers, and customize the plant-care scene. Create your home oasis with smart OasisMist
Easier One-Step Refill: Enjoy hassle-free top-fill by adding water to the top of the tank without flipping it over. Plus, the thoughtful handle design makes cleaning just as easy
2-in-1 Diffuser: Add essential oils to the aroma pad for a fragrant, relaxing space. Plus, noise levels as low as 26dB make the OasisMist ideal for nurseries and offices
Also, we recommend using distilled/ purified water better for your health.
description: Introduce our OasisMist Smart Warm & Cool Mist Humidifier. With VortexMist Technology, it gives you a faster, healthier, smarter, and easier humidification experience. Also, distilled/ purified water is preferred  for your health.

Toubleshooting
1.LEVOIT Water Filter Sponge.
Why to use: Capture and filter fine impurities and particles, to improve humidifying efficiency in a healthier way.
When to change: Generally lasts 1 month depending on hardness of water.
Where to buy: Please search B09ZY9N6PD on Amazon.
2. LEVOIT 10 Pack Humidifier Mineral Absorption Pads.
Why to use: Prevent Stubborn Mineral Buildup and Increase Humidification Efficiency.
When to change: Generally last 2-4 weeks (Depending on the hardness of the water).
Where to buy: Please search B09X9PLMYC or Levoit humidifier replacement filter.

3.LEVOIT Aroma PadsWhy you need it: To help emit a stronger fragrance and protect the fragrance box.When to change: We suggest the aroma pads be changed every 4 weeks for better performance.Where to buy: Please search B0B8MD45FB or Levoit aroma pads for more information.
